UPDATE backup_runs
        SET
            status = $2,
            snapshot_id = COALESCE($3, snapshot_id),
            error_message = $4,
            completed_at = CASE
                WHEN $2 IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'restore_check_succeeded', 'restore_check_failed')
                THEN now()
                ELSE completed_at
            END,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1
        RETURNING id, status, snapshot_id
